description: Claude Code profiles for codefreedom — each profile sets model selection, API endpoint, and auth explicitly.
notes: All profiles share the same ~/.claude and workspace/.claude directories.
'default' is the base profile — 'ultra', 'pro', and 'air' inherit from it.
'bare' is standalone: it sets NO auth or endpoint, so Claude Code uses its default Anthropic authentication (OAuth/login).
Inheritance: default vars → profile vars (profile vars win on conflict).
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN must be set explicitly per profile.
Secrets (~/.env.secrets) are loaded but profiles define their own auth explicitly.

default.description: Base profile — routes through local LiteLLM proxy. Other profiles inherit from this.

bare.description: Standalone — no proxy config, no model aliases. Claude Code uses its native Anthropic authentication (OAuth/login).

ultra.description: Inherits from 'default' — overrides CLAUDE_MODEL to CodeFreedom/Ultra for architecture and planning

pro.description: Inherits from 'default' — uses local/small model (CodeFreedom/Pro) for bounded implementation

air.description: Inherits from 'default' — uses lightweight scanning model (CodeFreedom/Air) for mechanical tasks
